signal: Reco raised a $30M Series B in Feb 2026, bringing total funding to $85M to meet surging enterprise AI SaaS security demand

email.body1:
Bob, saw Reco closed its $30M Series B and is scaling fast against enterprise demand for AI SaaS security.

Growth that quick usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Reco off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bob, quick follow-up for Reco.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can catch up. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Reco needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bob, last bit of proof for Reco.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reco's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bob, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Reco either way.
